actions.action: Separate naming directions from wording variants
actions.mechanism: Group suggestions by their stated purpose, not spelling similarity; allow one name to serve multiple directions.
actions.implementation: Add rationale and addressed-constraint fields. Make grouping reversible, preserving original submissions and private author links. Display every direction, including singletons.
actions.check: Submit two similar names with different rationales; verify both directions remain visible and either original can be recovered.
actions.risk: Grouping labels can misrepresent intent; let contributors contest them.

actions.action: Give late suggestions an anonymous first review
actions.mechanism: An explicit unreviewed queue gives newcomers review access independent of existing popularity, without selecting a winner.
actions.implementation: Show reviewers names, rationales, and constraints without authors or reactions. Keep authorship access-controlled; provide an identity-leak preview. Use visible submission-order rotation.
actions.check: Add a late alternative after extensive discussion; verify it receives a review slot without exposing its author or earlier reactions.
actions.risk: Writing style may reveal identity; anonymity is not guaranteed.

actions.mechanism: Rejections reference specific constraint versions, making their continued applicability inspectable when requirements change.
actions.implementation: Store rejection explanations and linked constraints. On a linked edit, mark the rejection 'needs reconsideration' and queue human review, preserving history.
actions.check: Reject a name for exceeding a length limit; increase that limit and verify reconsideration appears without erasing the rejection.
actions.risk: Frequent edits may overload review; batch notices without hiding unresolved items.

actions.action: Expose hard-constraint conflicts beside every name
actions.mechanism: A constraint matrix separates requirement compliance from enthusiasm, leaving disputed interpretations visible rather than automatically eliminating suggestions.
actions.implementation: Mark constraints hard or preferred. Record pass, fail, or unknown with evidence for each name; display unresolved hard failures wherever that name appears.
actions.check: Give a popular name a documented hard-constraint failure; verify the warning persists in grouped views and no winner is selected.
actions.risk: Subjective constraints need human assessment; unknown must not imply pass.
